record.title: From 2 min 20 to 10 seconds.
paragraphs: Strasbourg, 18 March 2026. The AWS Clash of Agents: eleven hours to get AI agents collaborating around an online pet shop. My first prototype answered in 2 min 20. Unacceptable. I spent the night reworking every process by hand.

By morning: 10 s. The organisers thought it was an anomaly and audited my code. Nothing to report. First prize, handed over by the CTO of AWS France, and an international record. It's not genius, it's sheer persistence.

bench.ariaLabel: Average agent response time: 2 minutes 20 before, 10 seconds after, that is 14 times faster.

items.title: The cloud, as a community
items.desc: Captain of the AWS Cloud Club Mulhouse since 2025. I run workshops on the AWS ecosystem and put together talks with Developer Advocates. Captain Silver distinction in 2026.

items.title: Hackathons
items.desc: Winner of the Nuit de l'info, BaselHack 2024 and 2025 with Team NFT, Epitech Game Jams, CARE Alsace award at the Hacking Health Camp with VisiSurg. One sleepless night, one team, one real problem: my favourite format.

items.title: Esports, behind the scenes
items.desc: Head of BSK Esport in Besançon since 2022. Running the association, live broadcast production, a real-time data acquisition tool, events like Ici C'est Besac, the Bug Days or tournaments in public libraries.

items.title: Passing it on
items.desc: Teaching assistant at Epitech since 2025: mentoring on projects, designing modules. Before that, treasurer of the student union and founder of the gaming club. Explaining is the best way to check that you've understood.

method.title: Understand before copying
method.desc: If I can't explain it to a first-year student, I haven't understood it.

method.title: Ship, then polish
method.desc: Something that runs at 3 a.m. beats a perfect plan at 9 a.m. Then we optimise.

method.title: Off screen
method.desc: Metal and rock, volunteering, organising events. And a console when there's time left.

items.title: VisiSurg
items.lead: Making a surgical report understandable by the patient who went through it.
items.desc: One weekend with caregivers and designers. The surgical report is translated into a 3D visualisation of the procedure, and a RAG chatbot answers the patient's questions relying solely on their own medical record. CARE Alsace award at the finish line.

items.title: ccprofile
items.lead: Claude Code plugin and skill profiles, per project, versioned in the repository.
items.desc: Instead of enabling everything globally, you define profiles (web, backend, mobile…) and apply them project by project. Skills are copied into the repository, plugins written to the committed config: any teammate or cloud container gets the right tooling without installing anything. Zero dependencies, Windows / macOS / Linux, drift detection included.

items.title: discord-kernel
items.lead: The “framework” half of a Discord bot, without the bot.
items.desc: Typed command DSL, guards (permissions, roles, cooldowns), interaction routing, persistent components, i18n that refuses to start on a duplicate key. The kernel only knows discord.js: database, logger and scheduler are ports the application implements. Clean Architecture enforced by the very fact of being a package.

parcours.title: Technique can be learned. Perseverance is cultivated.

items.desc: Eleven hours, one night, one record. Then the CARE Alsace award at the Hacking Health Camp with VisiSurg, and Anthropic's Claude Code in Action certification the same year.
AWS workshops, talks with Developer Advocates, coordinating the student community. Captain Silver in 2026.
Technical mentoring of students, designing and running modules. Alongside that, a few freelance assignments on top of my studies.
AI agent for PDF data extraction, AWS cloud architectures, AI pipeline optimisation. My first 100% cloud environment.
Treasurer of the student union, founder of the gaming club. Winner of the Nuit de l'info, BaselHack 2024 and 2025, Game Jams. Lots of C, then C++, then everything else.
Product label generation app, then redesign of the “Idéal Parquets” showcase website. The moment code became a profession.
Where it all started: an esports association, a website to build, a live production setup to put together, events to organise. My first full-scale playground.

items.text: “We particularly appreciated his ability to work around technical obstacles while meeting deadlines. A reliable, skilled and proactive developer.”
